title: Annex 71 N2 four-air-body production diagnostic

numerical_tolerances.later_period_temperature_rmse_c: less than or equal to 1.0 degC
numerical_tolerances.later_period_absolute_temperature_bias_c: less than or equal to 0.5 degC
numerical_tolerances.thermal_balance_residual_w: less than or equal to 1e-7 W
numerical_tolerances.parameter_bound_margin: at least 1 percent of the declared interval

known_deviations: This is post-hoc same-experiment diagnosis, not blind or untouched validation; later targets were inspected during mapper repair.
Temperature RMSE and bias still fail after the explicit heater split and supply-air path repair; effective capacity approaches its upper bound and the optimizer exhausts its evaluation budget.
Canonical v1 still lacks per-opening blind state, detailed construction layers, cellar boundaries, and measurement uncertainty.
The run conserves thermal energy and uses no fallback, so numerical balance leakage does not explain the empirical residual.
